description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.

Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.

Retail and Marcom Engineering, an IS&T team, builds and operates the systems and experiences that connect Apple's products with its customers. The team owns the technology behind both Apple's online and physical stores and drives the interactive marketing experiences and tools that keep creative operations moving. Together, those functions deliver the technology behind every product story Apple tells and every purchase a customer makes.

Description
The Marcom Engineering Productivity group builds the internal tools that empower teams across Apple to deliver world-class marketing pages on apple.com. We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our team to shape and grow our content authoring platform. Key features of this platform include WYSIWYG page building, AI-assisted content authoring, and workflows that accelerate our web page delivery process. In this role, you’ll work across the full stack, including React component front-end interfaces, Next.js server-side rendering, and Node.js microservices. You’ll have direct influence in how Apple delivers amazing product experiences on the web.

Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain features across our internal content authoring platform, spanning UI building, server-side rendering, and backend services
Build and improve WYSIWYG and AI-assisted authoring workflows that streamline how teams create and publish marketing content for apple.com
Develop and operate Node.js microservices that support the platform’s backend infrastructure
Collaborate with designers, product managers, and partner engineering teams to translate requirements into well-architected technical solutions
Write clean, testable, well-documented TypeScript code and participate in thorough code reviews
Contribute to frontend component libraries and shared tooling used across the authoring platform
Identify and address performance bottlenecks, reliability issues, and opportunities for developer experience improvements

Minimum qualifications
3 years of professional software engineering experience
Proficiency in TypeScript
Experience building applications with Node.js, React, and server-side rendering frameworks (next.js or similar)
Familiarity with modern front-end development practices (component-based architecture, state management, responsive design)
Experience with RESTful APIs and/or GraphQL
BS/MS in Computer Science or similar degree, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred qualifications
Experience deploying and operating production Node.js microservices
Experience building GUI applications (for internal or external users) for WYSIWYG page authoring, headless content management, or similar visual authoring platforms
Experience integrating LLM-driven agentic capabilities into user-facing applications
Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud native infrastructure
Developed production web applications for high traffic / high visibility sites
Strong communication skills and experience collaborating in enterprise scale cross-functional teams
